<!-- Source: xgen/screens/src/authoring/blocks/landing.ts -->
<!--
  A section with a heading and the questions. Axes: layout (accordion: native disclosures that open without
  script; chat: question and answer as alternating bubbles), columns (1, 2), search mode (none, field: a search
  field above; the page filters by `search.query`), filter mode (none, categories: tabs above; the page filters
  by `filter.category`), density, tone.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Faq, FaqTab, FaqSearch, FaqFilter } from "./faq-list.types";

  export type FaqListProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    items: Faq[];
    search?: FaqSearch;
    filter?: FaqFilter;
    layout?: "accordion" | "chat";
    cols?: "1" | "2";
    multiple?: boolean;
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
    onquery?: (text: string) => void;
    oncategory?: (value: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Disclosure from "../primitives/disclosure/disclosure.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Summary from "../primitives/disclosure/summary.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import SearchField from "../components/search-field.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import Switcher from "../components/switcher.svelte";
  import SwitcherItem from "../components/switcher-item.svelte";
  import { tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    items,
    search,
    filter,
    layout = "accordion",
    cols = "1",
    multiple = false,
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
    onquery,
    oncategory,
  }: FaqListProps = $props();
  const inCategory = $derived(items.filter((i) => !filter?.category || i["category"] === filter?.category));
  const shown = $derived(inCategory.filter((i) => !search?.query || String(i["question"]).toLowerCase().includes(String(search?.query).toLowerCase())));
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  measure={(((layout as string) === "chat") ? "2xl" : "default")}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  {#if (search?.mode === "field")}
    <SearchField
      label={(search?.label ?? "")}
      placeholder={search?.label}
      value={(search?.query ?? "")}
      onvalue={(arg: string) => onquery?.(arg)}
    />
  {/if}
  {#if (filter?.mode === "categories")}
    <Switcher label={filter?.label}>
      {#each filter?.tabs as tab (tab.id)}
        <SwitcherItem active={(tab.value === filter?.category)} onclick={() => oncategory?.(tab.value)}>
          {tab.title}
        </SwitcherItem>
      {/each}
    </Switcher>
  {/if}
  {#if ((layout as string) === "chat")}
    <Stack gap="4" align="stretch" data-testid="faq">
      {#each shown as item (item.id)}
        <Stack gap="2" align="stretch" data-testid="faq-item">
          <Box class="ml-auto max-w-xs sm:max-w-md rounded bg-primary px-4 py-4 text-primary-foreground">
            <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
              {item.question}
            </Text>
          </Box>
          <Box class="mr-auto max-w-xs sm:max-w-md rounded bg-muted px-4 py-4">
            <Text size="sm">
              {item.answer}
            </Text>
          </Box>
        </Stack>
      {/each}
    </Stack>
  {:else}
    <Grid cols={(((cols as string) === "2") ? "1-2" : "1")} class="items-start gap-x-8" data-testid="faq">
      {#each shown as item (item.id)}
        <Disclosure variant="item" name={(multiple ? undefined : tpl("{0}-faq", (id ?? "faq")))} data-testid="faq-item">
          <Summary variant="item">
            {item.question}
          </Summary>
          <Text size="sm" class="pb-4 text-muted-foreground">
            {item.answer}
          </Text>
        </Disclosure>
      {/each}
    </Grid>
  {/if}
</SectionFrame>
